name: UAC Cross Country Championships
headline: UAC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Eastern Kentucky swept the UAC titles. The men scored 15 points to UT Arlington's 85 and Central Arkansas' 91, with Abel Kirui winning the 8K in 23:52.6. The women scored 20 to UT Arlington's 53 and Central Arkansas' 87, with Brighter Jepchumba winning the 5K in 16:24.4.
